queue.title: Orders Pipeline
queue.description: Operations agents can inspect all orders, handle verifications, process transitions, and track fulfillment without leaving the admin workspace.

table.title: All orders
table.noPermission: Your staff account does not have permission to view orders.
table.noMatchesHint: Try a wider time period, another status, or clear the filters.
table.emptyHint: New storefront orders appear here in real time.

messages.statusFailedHint: The status was not changed. Try again.

details.description: Review the uploaded proof, optionally attach a manual fallback receipt, and transition the order when stock is still available.

financials.title: Profitability Snapshot
financials.redacted: This staff account can process the order, but financial metrics are redacted server-side.

receipt.missing: No receipt is attached yet. Use the manual fallback flow.

actions.logisticsNote: Shipping and logistical transitions beyond verification take place here. Full FSM extension for Courier tracking pending.

overrideModal.title: Manual Override
overrideModal.description: Change the order status arbitrarily. You may optionally attach  a receipt.
overrideModal.stockNote: Moving into or out of Confirmed, Ready for Shipping, Shipped or Delivered adjusts real stock automatically.
overrideModal.paymentLocked: Statuses that confirm payment need the Verify Payments permission.
overrideModal.destructiveNote: Moving this order to {state} takes it out of the fulfillment flow.

modal.title: Manual Fallback
modal.description: Attach a manual WhatsApp receipt if the customer proof needs to be uploaded directly from the admin workstation.

messages.rtoConfirm: Are you sure you want to mark this order as Return to Origin? This will automatically restock the SKU.
messages.rtoSuccess: Order marked as RTO. Inventory restocked.
messages.outOfStockDescription: Another agent depleted the remaining stock before confirmation. The order was not confirmed.
messages.needsVerifyPayments: This change confirms payment, so it needs the Verify Payments permission. Nothing was uploaded or changed.
messages.uploadFailed: The receipt couldn’t be uploaded. Check the file and try again.

details.notFoundHint: It may have been merged into another order, or the link is wrong.

journey.label: Order progress
journey.exited: {state} — this order has left the fulfillment flow.

decision.verifyBody: Compare the receipt with the amount due. The amount and transfer reference should match before you verify.
decision.noReceipt: The customer hasn’t sent a receipt yet. Upload one from WhatsApp to verify, or mark the payment stalled.
decision.verifyRestricted: Confirming payment needs the Verify Payments permission. Ask a teammate who has it to review this order.

next.CONFIRMED: Payment is verified. Pack the order, then mark it ready for the courier.
next.READY_FOR_SHIPPING: Hand the parcel to the courier, then mark it shipped.
next.SHIPPED: Mark it delivered once the courier confirms, or return it to origin if it came back.

idle.PENDING_PAYMENT_INPUT: Waiting for the customer to submit payment. Nothing to do yet.
idle.STALLED_PAYMENT: Payment never arrived. Contact the customer, or use Manual Update if they pay later.
idle.FLAGGED_FRAUD: Held for review. Don’t ship until it is cleared with Manual Update.
idle.RTO: Returned to origin. Stock has been restocked.

confirm.verifyBody: Verifying confirms the order, deducts real stock, and is recorded in the audit log.
confirm.cancelBody: The customer’s order will be closed. You can still restore it later with Manual Update.
confirm.stallBody: Use this when the customer hasn’t paid. The order leaves the verification queue.

Orders.fulfilmentLocked: Confirm the order before moving it to shipping or delivery.
